scenario: Money: a new creator names a rate (Block 3)
subject: Re: Fernwell x Maya Codes - paid collab?

messages.body:
Hey Maya,

I'm Sam from Fernwell's creator partnerships team. Your weekly 'study with me' uploads are some of the most consistent in the productivity space, and your viewers are exactly the students Fernwell is built for.

Would you be open to a paid collaboration with us? Happy to share ideas and scope once I know you're interested.

No rush either way, just let me know :)

Hi Sam,

Thanks for reaching out, I actually tried Fernwell last semester so this is a fun one.

My rate for a 60-90 second integration in a long-form video is $2,400 USD. My last 10 videos average around 41,000 views and about 70% of my audience is in the US, UK and Canada.

Let me know if that works!

Maya
